results.snippet:
Niger has accused the company and France of benefiting unfairly from its uranium resources. 

The government is also challenging the terms under which the country’s uranium was mined and sold.

In June 2025, Niger nationalised SOMAÏR, a mining company previously majority-owned by Orano.

In May 2026, Niger also cancelled a mining concession dating back to 1968, further escalating the dispute.
